note: 7v (PROVEN): read DVD STRUCTURE copyright/key (0xAD) from netemu partition then READ(10). copyright=0 (CPM=0, no CSS), but READ(10) STILL 0 bytes -> reading the key structure does NOT unlock content. Route A (replay PS2 disc auth as plain ATAPI from netemu) empirically BLOCKED: the content gate needs the secure 0x4b handshake (ss_server3 + disc keys), not a replayable CDB. Direct/firmware optical-read route is a dead end without secure-module keys. Realistic paths: B run ps2_softemu (has the auth subsystem), or C stage to HDD ISO (copy). See docs/COBRA_FEEDS_NETEMU_SCOPE.md.

stages.name: Patch / install / test pipeline and durable HDD log
Netemu partition talks to the drive (open, DMA map, ATAPI commands)
Disc authentication (likely required for any data read)
Level 2: emulator disc layer reads from the drive (boot)
Level 4: usable (app, stub ISO, configs, no-disc messages)
